split_note: 'cross_scroll' is a labelled reporting convention, not held-out secrecy: the ground truth comes from a public villa dataset and cannot be hidden. This split exists to report transfer across scrolls, not to withhold labels from entrants.

ground_truth.origin: villa fiber-skeletons dataset, dl.ash2txt.org/datasets/fiber-skeletons/ — every papyrus fiber in the cube hand-traced in WEBKNOSSOS at 7.91 um
ground_truth.note: n_fibers is every fiber in the raw NML trace. n_fibers_scored (and floors.*.n_gt_fibers) is smaller: it excludes fibers with 0 or 1 in-bounds nodes, since a fiber needs at least two in-bounds nodes to contribute a measurable run. Annotators traced beyond the cube boundary, so this gap reaches 10% on the shipped cubes.
ground_truth.placement_note: Exploratory measurement, vesuvius-autoresearch PR #157 (reports/neural_tracer_entrant.md, reports/neural_tracer_gt_offset.json, 2026-10-20): the hand-traced centrelines here sit about a voxel off the fibers' centres in the CT. Two thin entrants, villa's neural tracer and #1934's generator, agree on a mean shift of (z, y, x) = (0.65, 0.27, 0.89) voxels (each the median displacement to the ground truth along an axis, over samples on fibers within 30 degrees of perpendicular to it). The CT alone, smoothed at sigma 1, is brightest 0.85 voxels off the hand-traced centreline in the same direction. Moving the neural tracer's centreline by the generator's shift raises its share within 2 voxels of the ground truth from 0.588 to 0.660. Measured after the fact, on 5 of the 11 in-sample cubes; it is part of the thin entrants' in-sample gap, not all of it. The ground truth and every row are unchanged.

convention_check.claim: NML nodes are x,y,z in absolute scroll space; volumes index z,y,x; the cube origin is encoded in the filename as <scroll>_<z>_<y>_<x>_<size>
convention_check.verified_against: labelsTr/s5_14997_01497_01497_256.tif (Dataset004_sk-fibers-binary-20250728, the semantic label of the same release)
convention_check.note_on_the_two_rates: measured_node_landing_rate_on_semantic_label is against labelsTr, villa's shipped semantic mask, and is at or above 0.999 on every shipped cube — the exporter refuses to ship one below that; the value measured for this cube is recorded above. That artifact is NOT what scoring uses. The figure that matters for scoring is measured_node_landing_rate_on_scoring_mask, against the fiber_hz_vt reference mask: lower, because the mask is a thresholded model output rather than a hand label, but many times chance, which is what establishes that skeleton and mask share a coordinate frame. Recomputed from shipped data by tests/test_fiber_target.py rather than trusted from this file.

mask.note: Every entrant built on this identical mask (the floors and our tracer) labels it, so their scorecard differences come from the instance labelling rather than from a better or worse segmentation. villa's neural tracer (0.8.0) is not built on it: it labels its own centrelines, with this mask's model as its presence input.
mask.generated: probability volume produced locally by running scrollprize/fiber_hz_vt over the cube, not downloaded from the villa dataset; thresholded at 0.5 to give the shipped mask

floors_external_source.tracer_strict_relink: vesuvius-autoresearch finding 80 labelling (reports/tracer_rescore.md, prereg f5f775c3 + Amendment 1 aa1c5712): bench_cli trace at its published defaults (relink on, tangent window 1, no skips, no seed NMS). Re-scored against the Dataset004 annotation in finding 82 (reports/scrollgt_current_annotations.md, prereg 6185a0a6), whose rows this reproduces exactly. Re-scored from the same labelling with scoring version 3 in ScrollGT 0.7.0; its version-2 row reproduces exactly as erl_covered and erl_merge_penalized_covered.
floors_external_source.villa_neural_tracer: vesuvius-autoresearch finding 91 (reports/neural_tracer_entrant.md, prereg 8a0d033f + amendment baa7e917, 2026-10-16): villa #2045's vesuvius.neural_tracing.tracers.fibers.tracing.volume at villa ccb431818, checkpoint scrollprize/fiber_single_small at 451182558cb3270cfc2ddf967acbd4f36b9b816b (last.pt sha256 3268a0ac1807debdeaded05fa7bc90b82d3ca8102125247e5cba688a10a4811f), volume mode, every default plus --ct-level 0 --ct-grid-scale 1 --grid-scale 2 --base-um 7.91 for a 7.91 um cube; presence = the probability of scrollprize/fiber_hz_vt, the reference mask's own model. Its .afv fibers are rasterised as thin centrelines (afv_to_labels.py: 0.25 vx samples, nearest sample wins a voxel). Deterministic: two repeated cubes reproduced exactly. Training (read from the checkpoint): 563 Scroll 1 (Paris 4) fibers and four automated fiber volumes (PHerc0175A, PHerc1447, PHerc0125, Paris 4 central); no Scroll 3 or Scroll 5. Pitch (vesuvius-autoresearch finding 92, reports/neural_tracer_pitch.md, prereg 5c052f7c, 2026-10-19): its Scroll-3 lead depends on running at the cubes' own 7.91 um. Resampled to 9.6 um, its Scroll 1 training pitch, and run with the same settings, it scores lower on all 21 cubes (merge-penalized ERL a median 0.63 of these rows) and leads our tracer on none of the 8 Scroll-3 cubes. These rows are the native run. Seeding (vesuvius-autoresearch finding 96, reports/neural_tracer_boundary.md, exploratory, 2026-10-23): it drops any seed whose 77-voxel CT window crosses the edge of the CT it is given, and it is given this cube alone, so its closest traced seed lay 38 voxels from a face. Here it dropped 0.571 of its seed dots as no_heading, and its output is 0.532 of the ground-truth length, against 0.26–0.36 and 0.83–1.43 on the 512³ cubes. These rows are its score under the protocol every entrant gets; how much real CT around the cube would change them is untested.
